research_notes_other.notes_from_film_list.txt: Investigates a wrongful conviction case set in the Bronx; May involve local community dynamics. Available via NBC/Peacock.
research_notes_other.research_findings: This episode focuses on Eric Glisson and five others convicted for a 1995 murder in the Bronx. The convictions rested heavily on a single eyewitness who was later deemed unreliable, leading to the exonerations after nearly two decades. Dateline followed the story, including Glisson's life after release. The episode title appears to be "In the Shadow of Justice: A Bronx Tale".
